body:
WORKTREE ui/node_modules RULE (Fable2, 2026-10-18 01:45Z), from TermAl w-affe gate test-e2706734's vitest failure. The log said "Error: Denied ID C:/github/Personal/TermAl/ui/node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js?url", and whole UI files failed with 0 failing tests.
Cause: the worktree's ui\node_modules was a JUNCTION to the main checkout's ui\node_modules, which is an old install (287 entries versus 400 from a fresh npm ci). Vite resolves the real path outside the worktree's allowed root and denies it.
About 90 .tmp\wt-* roots carry this junction.
RULES:
(1) Before any full gate or UI focused run, a lane checks that `(Get-Item <root>\ui\node_modules -Force).LinkType` is empty. If it is a Junction, remove ONLY the link (`cmd /c rmdir "<path>"`), then run `npm ci` in <root>\ui.
(2) NEVER remove a junctioned node_modules with Remove-Item -Recurse or rm -rf: it can delete the main checkout's packages. Any worktree cleanup must unlink junctions first. This is relevant to the audited release w-52222f575b81.
